installCommand: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), cp = require('child_process'); console.log('Vercel CWD:', process.cwd()); const dir = fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json') ? buildCommand: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), cp = require('child_process'); console.log('Vercel CWD:', process.cwd()); const dir = fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json') ? 'frontend' : (fs.existsSync('front-end/package.json') ? 'front-end' : (fs.existsSync('package.json') ? '.' : (fs.existsSync('../package.json') ? '..' : ''))); console.log('Build target:', dir); if (dir) { cp.execSync(dir === '.' ? 'npm run build' : ('cd ' + dir + ' && npm run build'), { stdio: 'inherit' }); const out = dir === '.' ?
